title: tls: TlsError::Io misused for config error
description: load_or_generate_cert returns the partial-presence error as TlsError::Io (via std::io::Error::new(InvalidInput)) — there is no dedicated TlsError variant for this configuration-level failure. Callers that pattern-match on TlsError::Io to decide whether to retry or report an I/O fault will misclassify this as a transient I/O error rather than a fatal misconfiguration.
